name: com.vanhaodev.addressablesencryption
description: AES-encrypts Addressables AssetBundles per group so asset rippers (AssetRipper, AssetStudio) cannot extract them. Pick which groups to encrypt, set the key at runtime (hardcoded or fetched from a server).

samples.description: One scene that loads a picture from an Addressables group. Add or remove the Encryption schema on the group to see the bundle encrypted or plain.
